title: helm(private): values schema & init hooks - upgrade/rollback compatibility and validation
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: customers running Redwood Private have seen upgrade instability when values/schema mismatches occur and when init jobs are not idempotent across rollbacks. This PR standardizes the Helm values schema for the private chart, adds robust init hooks for secrets/config bootstrapping, and improves templating so upgrades and rollbacks are validated and safe. Changes include: 1) formal values.schema.json for the private chart with tighter validation and helpful error messages, 2) initJob hooks for kms/secret-bootstrap that are idempotent and guarded by helm tests, 3) pre-upgrade and pre-delete hooks that validate CRD compatibility (CRD checks only run in upgrade paths), 4) templating changes to remove direct chart-only defaults and surface mismatch warnings when a user pins a legacy values layout, 5) documented migration steps and automated compatibility transformations for common legacy keys. Checklist: - [x] Add values.schema.json and schema-aware error messages in chart README - [x] Implement initJob hooks (k8s Job + ownerReferences) with backoffLimit/ttlSecondsAfterFinished - [x] Add helm test and CI jobs: helm lint, helm unit tests, smoke e2e on kind - [x] Add migration helpers and sample k8s manifests to docs - [x] Add Linear link in PR and tests for rollback scenario Notes: this PR focuses on safety and compatibility rather than changing runtime behavior. Follow-ups will expose more granular KMS configs and optional pre-populate steps for air-gapped installs. See ENG-4125 for background and SUP-1023 for customer repro.
